title: Pair request
description: Body of POST /v1/pair (plan 15.2, ADR-0008). Sent only over a TLS connection whose certificate matched the pairing payload's spki_sha256. invitation_secret is a credential and is never logged or persisted by either side; the Mac compares its SHA-256 in constant time.

source_id.description: The source the phone expects, from the pairing payload. A mismatch is refused (source binding).

device_id.description: Generated on the phone; one per installation and source.

device_name.description: Shown to the Mac user for approval.
